content.short: 0xScope is a Web3 data intelligence layer that provides AI-powered analytics and deep insights into blockchain entities and relationships.
content.description: 0xScope is building a comprehensive data layer for Web3 that uses AI to analyze on-chain data and identify real-world entities. By mapping relationships between wallets, tokens, and protocols, 0xScope provides deep behavioral analytics and risk assessment tools for developers and users. Its ecosystem includes Scopechat (an AI trading assistant) and Scopescan (a sophisticated on-chain analytics platform) which are integrated with the Mantle Network to provide enhanced transparency and data-driven insights for the community.
content.meta: 0xScope provides AI-powered Web3 data intelligence and behavioral analytics for the Mantle ecosystem. Discover 0xScope on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
